verdict.rationale: Otter's own materials say you can record directly from the Mac or Windows desktop app "without bots joining the call" and "record bot-free" (otter-docs-2, otter-docs-38), and that impromptu Google Meet calls can be captured without a bot present (otter-docs-15). Community complaints about the bot joining calls concern the separate scheduled-notetaker mode, so they do not contradict the bot-free path. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how device audio capture works across platforms (e.g. Zoom/Teams desktop audio), confirmation that external participants receive no auto-shared notes or notifications in bot-free mode, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
